notes: The image labels the breadboard's upper half rows j-f and lower half rows e-a; the catalogue's 't' bank is rows a-e and 'b' bank is rows f-j, so the visually lower half is bank 't' and the upper half is bank 'b'.
Pot legs are read from the image at columns 11, 12 and 13. The outer legs sit in the lower half (11t.e and 13t.e) and the wiper sits in the upper half (12b.f).
The black wire goes to the second GND header pin (GND.2) next to the POWER label. The red wire goes to 5V and the yellow wire goes to A0.
The image shows the wire ends one row away from the pot legs, in the same column strip. I put them at rows d (lower half) and g (upper half) so they share a strip with the pot leg.
The USB cable is in the parts list but not drawn in the circuit. I connected it to the Uno for power and serial communication with the computer. It has no ports, and the computer is not modelled.
